doc.title: 3DPMQ – 3D Printer Makerspace Queue
app.subtitle: 3D Printer Makerspace Queue
submit.title: Submit a print
submit.intro: Slice your model in PrusaSlicer, export the G-code (Ctrl+G / ⌘G), then drop it here.
submit.drop: Drop a .gcode or .bgcode file here, or click to choose
submit.sent: Request #{id} sent. Staff will review it.
form.name: Your name
form.classPh: choose or type a new one
form.classHint: Only staff members can leave the class empty.
form.what: What do you want to print?
form.hintFix: Fix the problems above, re-slice, and drop the new file.
combo.empty: No classes yet. Type a name to create the first one.
queue.title: Print queue
queue.empty: Nothing in the queue. Submit a print.
printers.title: Printers
printers.none: No printers configured yet. Staff can add them on the Staff page.
staff.title: Staff
refused.title: Refused and cancelled ({n})
refused.confirmClear.one: Remove the refused or cancelled request from the list? Its G-code file is deleted. Finished prints are not touched.
refused.confirmClear.other: Remove all {n} refused and cancelled requests from the list? Their G-code files are deleted. Finished prints are not touched.
review.previewTitle: Opens a 3D view of the toolpath in a new window
review.rejectPrompt: Reason for rejecting (shown to the user):
review.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the pop-up window. Please allow pop-ups for this site.
ready.help: Order: priority, then approval time. "Start" uploads the G-code to the printer and begins printing – only press it when the bed is clear and the right filament is loaded.
ready.noneLoaded: No printer has this filament loaded:
ready.confirmStart: Bed clear and correct filament loaded? The job will be uploaded and started now.
ready.confirmAnyway: The requested filament is NOT marked as loaded on this printer. Start anyway?
pform.name: Name
pform.model: Printer model (as in the G-code, e.g. MK4S)
pform.autoStart: Auto-start next job when "bed is clear" is set
fil.help: This list is what users can choose from, and what you assign to printers as "loaded".
rules.onlyPrusa: Only accept files generated by PrusaSlicer
people.name: Name
people.classRequired: A class is required unless the role is Staff
people.totals: Totals per class and per month
people.statsNote: Statistics count finished prints in full and prints that were stopped part-way by the share that was printed. Weights are the slicer's estimate.
people.summary: {prints} completed print(s) · {grams} of plastic · {time} print time
people.confirmPurge: Remove {name} AND delete all their requests, files and statistics? This cannot be undone.
people.confirmRemove: Remove {name}? Name, e-mail and class are erased everywhere. Their prints stay as anonymous statistics. This cannot be undone.
classes.title: Classes ({n})
classes.help: Classes appear here automatically when a new one is typed on the request form or in the person editor. Rename fixes typos for everybody in the class; a class can only be deleted when nobody is in it.
classes.moveFirst: Move the people to another class first
pv.title: 3D preview – 3DPMQ
pv.help: Drag: rotate · Wheel: zoom · Right-drag or Shift-drag: move · Double-click: reset · ↑/↓: layer
pv.noWebgl: This browser cannot do WebGL 2, so the 3D preview is not available.
pv.login: Please log in as staff in the main window, then reload this window.
pv.noMoves: This file contains no extrusion moves to show.
pv.truncated: Very large file: only the first {n} moves (up to Z {z} mm) are shown.
err.emailInvalid: A valid e-mail address is required
err.roleInvalid: Role must be student, staff or other
err.emailDuplicate: Another person already uses this e-mail address
err.classRequired: A class is required unless the role is Staff
err.openRequests: {name} has {n} open request(s). Reject or cancel them first.
err.classNameTaken: Another class already has this name
err.classInUse.one: {n} person is in class {name}. Move them to another class first.
err.classInUse.other: {n} people are in class {name}. Move them to another class first.
err.removeNotAllowed: Only refused or cancelled requests that never started can be removed
err.printerUnavailable: Printer is not available (offline, busy or needs attention)
err.filamentNotLoaded: The requested filament is not loaded on this printer
err.cancelForbidden: Only the submitter or staff can cancel this request
err.cannotCancel: Cannot cancel a request that is {status}
err.unreachableNotStopped: Printer not reachable, the print was NOT stopped: {detail}
err.printerNotStopped: The printer did not stop the print: {detail}
err.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts, try again later
err.previewFailed: The file could not be read for the preview: {detail}
err.nozzleRange: Nozzle must be between 0 and 2 mm
err.noRunningJob: No running job on this printer
err.filamentFields: Material and colour name are required
iss.name: Please enter your name.
iss.email: Please enter a valid e-mail address.
iss.what: Please say what you want to print.
iss.use: Please say what the print will be used for.
iss.active-limit: You already have {active} open requests (limit {max}). Wait until one finishes.
iss.quota: Monthly quota exceeded: {used} g used + {requested} g requested > {max} g.
iss.name-differs: Typed name "{typed}" differs from the registered name "{registered}" for this e-mail.
iss.class-differs: Typed class "{typed}" differs from the registered class "{registered}".
iss.file-type: Only sliced G-code files (.gcode or .bgcode) are accepted. Slice your model in PrusaSlicer first and export G-code.
iss.unreadable: Could not read the G-code metadata{detail}. Re-export from PrusaSlicer.
iss.no-metadata: No slicer metadata found in this file. Please export directly from PrusaSlicer.
iss.slicer: This file was generated by "{generator}". Please slice with PrusaSlicer.
iss.slicer-unknown: This file was generated by "an unknown program". Please slice with PrusaSlicer.
iss.printer-model-missing: The file does not say which printer model it was sliced for. Select the correct printer profile in PrusaSlicer.
iss.printer-model-mismatch: This file is sliced for "{model}". Printers available here: {known}.
iss.printer-model-none: This file is sliced for "{model}". Printers available here: none configured.
iss.no-printers: No printers are configured yet; the request will wait in the queue.
iss.nozzle: This file needs a {nozzle} mm nozzle; no matching {model} has one.
iss.material: The file does not contain a filament type.
iss.multi-material: Multi-material / multi-colour prints are not allowed.
iss.filament-mismatch: You selected {material} {colour}, but the file is sliced for {types}. Change the filament profile in PrusaSlicer or pick the matching filament.
iss.filament-not-loaded: {material} {colour} is not loaded on any printer right now; staff will load it before your print starts.
iss.no-time: No print-time estimate found in the file.
iss.too-long: Estimated print time is {hours} h; the limit is {max} h.
iss.no-weight: No filament weight found in the file.
iss.too-heavy: This print uses {grams} g of filament; the limit is {max} g.
iss.nozzle-temp: Nozzle temperature {temp} °C exceeds the limit of {max} °C.
iss.bed-temp: Bed temperature {temp} °C exceeds the limit of {max} °C.
iss.forbidden-gcode: The file contains commands that change printer settings or firmware: {cmds}.
iss.pauses: The file pauses the printer {n}× (M600/M0/M1). Someone must be at the printer.
iss.unscanned: The G-code commands in this file could not be checked automatically. Staff should review it more carefully.
